answer: Random peer audit stops bulk fakes. Each epoch a beacon gives every agent 5 falcon auditors; nobody chooses its reviewers. Each auditor checks the auditee's vertex: distinct counterparties, settled trades, and an echo matching its history. Passing costs a 300 POA bond, refunded with a 40 POA bonus. Forging 1,000 identities costs 300,000 POA; auditors catch false echoes, slash most bonds. An honest agent pays once, passes once, keeps its bonus.
